title: Four words in a notebook
body: For years my great-grandfather was only a name on the back of a photo. He was gone many years before my birth, and nobody at home talked about him much. Last spring my grandmother opened an old tin box. Inside there were letters, a pair of glasses and a small notebook. "He was a doctor who walked from village to village," she said. "In winter the river froze, and he was the only person who would cross it at night." I asked what he was like. "He was a quiet man whom the children were never afraid of." In the notebook I found lists of names and dates. Beside one name he wrote four words: "She is walking again." My grandmother is the only person who still remembers his voice. The old people who live along that river still know his name. Now I keep the notebook on my desk. I do not know most of the people whom he helped. But when I am tired of a hard question, I read those four words, and I keep going.

questions.q: Why did the writer know little about his great-grandfather?
options: Because the family lost all his letters.
Because he was gone many years before the writer was born and nobody talked about him.
Because he lived in another country.
Because his photo was thrown away.
questions.explanation: 'He was gone many years before my birth, and nobody at home talked about him much.'

questions.q: What did the grandmother find in the old tin box?
options: A pair of shoes and a map.
A photo and a river stone.
Some money and a school report.
Letters, a pair of glasses and a small notebook.
questions.explanation: 'Inside there were letters, a pair of glasses and a small notebook.'

questions.q: What kind of person was the great-grandfather?
options: A quiet doctor who helped people in far villages.
A soldier who fought in many places.
A teacher who wrote long letters.
A worker who built a bridge over the river.
questions.explanation: 'He was a doctor who walked from village to village' 与 'He was a quiet man whom the children were never afraid of.'

questions.q: What do the four words "She is walking again" tell us?
options: The great-grandfather liked walking at night.
A patient left the village on foot.
Someone he treated got better.
The notebook was written by a child.
questions.explanation: 四个词写在一个病人名字旁边,说明这位病人在他医治后重新站了起来。

questions.q: Why does the writer keep the notebook on his desk?
options: Because it is worth a lot of money.
Because those four words give him courage when work is hard.
Because his grandmother asked him to keep it.
Because he wants to write in it himself.
questions.explanation: 'when I am tired of a hard question, I read those four words, and I keep going.'
